intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Han is a family of rectangular industrial connectors, not one fixed pinout. A configuration may include hood, housing, monobloc insert or Han-Modular frame, power/signal/data modules, contacts, latches and cable entry. Electrical and environmental performance belongs to the specified complete assembly and its installation conditions.
copy.zh: Han 是矩形工业连接器家族，不是一种固定针位的插头。选型可能涉及外壳、底座、单体插芯或 Han-Modular 框架、功率／信号／数据模块、触点、锁扣与进线件。实际电气和环境能力取决于所选整套部件及其装配条件。

copy.en: For quotation, provide the Han series and housing size; part numbers for each hood, base, insert or module and contact; mating-face view, pin and circuit map, load and voltage, conductors and jacket, cable-exit direction, gland and latch choice, environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Compatible work does not imply HARTING authorization or certification.
copy.zh: 询价请提供 Han 系列与外壳尺寸、每个外壳／底座／插芯或模块／触点的料号、对插面视图、针脚与回路表、负载与电压、导体和护套、出线方向、格兰头与锁扣形式、安装环境、数量及验收要求。品牌兼容不代表 HARTING 授权或认证。

copy.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, circuit drawing, termination and assembly instructions, first-article checkpoints and agreed inspections. Check insert orientation, contact position and seating, latch closure, cable-entry retention, length and continuity. IP, vibration or rated-load performance requires the exact product data and separately defined project evidence.
copy.zh: 经客户确认后形成受控物料表、回路图、端接与装配指引、首件核对点和约定检验项目。重点核对插芯朝向、接点位置、触点入位、锁扣闭合、进线夹持、线长与导通；IP、防振或额定负载表现须按准确产品资料与项目试验单独证明。

copy.en: Identify the mating part number and termination method before confirming the assembly drawing.
copy.zh: 确认对插件料号和端接方式，再确定组件图纸。

copy.en: Compare the sample with the approved pin map, dimensions and material list.
copy.zh: 按确认的针脚对应、尺寸和材料清单审核样品。

copy.en: Retain the approved part list and inspection results for repeat production.
copy.zh: 保留确认物料清单与检验结果，作为重复生产依据。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
